title: Finite clopen decomposition of affine étale schemes over closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be an affine [def-pc-scheme] integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] which is normal (every local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]) and whose function field (the local ring at the generic point) is separably closed [def-pc-separably-closed]. Let $Z\subseteq X$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $V\to Z$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $V$ affine. Then $V$ is a finite disjoint union of open subschemes of $Z$: $V=V_1\amalg\dots\amalg V_n$ with each $V_i$ open and closed in $V$ and each restriction $V_i\to Z$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion].

source.place: Stacks Tag 09ZA, proof, first paragraph; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09ZA

proof.text: Lift the affine étale scheme across the closed immersion, obtaining affine U, étale q : U → X and a cartesian square (a,p,q,i).
The affine q is separated. Apply the proved upstream finite version of 09Z9 to q (compactness follows from affineness), then reindex its finite family by Fin n.
Each open is closed: its complement is the union of the other pairwise disjoint opens. Preimages along a preserve closedness and disjointness and cover V.
Paste the restriction pullback square with the lifting square. The map from each restricted open of V to Z is a base change of the corresponding open immersion to X.
